waypoints.name: White Salmon Road (hairpin) TH
waypoints.note: Hairpin turn onto NF-3075 off SR542 near mile 51-52, just before the White Salmon Day Lodge.
waypoints.directions: Drive the Mount Baker Highway (SR-542) to the town of Glacier and stop at the Glacier Public Service Center for the backcountry permit — it's required, not optional. Continue up SR-542 to around mile 51-52 and take the hairpin turn onto NF-3075 (White Salmon Road), just before the White Salmon Day Lodge, to the small pull-off at the old White Salmon Lodge site.

approach_logistics.trailhead: White Salmon Day-Lodge Area (FR-3075, Mt. Baker Ski Area)
approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From the White Salmon day-lodge area on SR-542 (White Salmon Road, FR-3075), via the old roadbed into the White Salmon Creek drainage
